definitions.explanation: The fourth planet from the Sun, known for its reddish appearance. Named with the characters for "fire" and "star" due to its red color.

examples.japanese: {火星|かせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
{火星|かせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Research into whether there is water on Mars is progressing.

examples.japanese: いつか⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{火星|かせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移住|いじゅう}する→移住する：17190_ijuusuru⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: The day may come when humanity migrates to Mars.

notes:
WRITING:
{火|か} (fire) + {星|せい} (star/planet). The name reflects the planet's reddish color, which the ancients associated with fire. This naming convention comes from the Chinese five-element system (⟦{五行|ごぎょう}→五行：28111_gogyou⟧).

THE PLANETS IN JAPANESE:
All planets in the solar system are named using the five-element system or descriptions:
- ⟦{水星|すいせい}→水星：18165_suisei⟧: Mercury (water)
- ⟦{金星|きんせい}→金星：15896_kinsei⟧: Venus (metal/gold)
- {火星|かせい}: Mars (fire)
- ⟦{木星|もくせい}→木星：13082_mokusei⟧: Jupiter (wood)
- ⟦{土星|どせい}→土星：18164_dosei⟧: Saturn (earth/soil)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火星|かせい}⟦{探査|たんさ}→探査：05325_tansa⟧: Mars exploration
- {火星|かせい}⟦{移住|いじゅう}→移住：13752_ijuu⟧: Mars colonization
- {火星|かせい}⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧: Martian
